conventions.id: Lowercase kebab slug. Never renamed or reused once a claims file cites it; a retired question gets replaced_by.
conventions.wording: Neutral: askable in the same words of a text from any snapshot, without a later period's concepts. The period's own terms go in names.
conventions.status: persistent = can be asked of any snapshot in the MVP; local = belongs to one snapshot's debates (kept so every claim has a question); anticipated = expected in 1575, 1675 or the three 1775 topics still to come, not yet drawn from a published entry.
conventions.names: Terms the texts read so far use, as 'lang: term'. expected_names are terms the period is known to use but not yet seen in our texts.
conventions.answers: Positions as codes. Add codes as texts are read; never change a code's meaning. A text that weighs answers without choosing gets stance 'undecided' with the codes in 'between'.
conventions.drawn_from: entry:part, where part is common, dispute, open, why, or place (a claim made where the text places the topic).
